description: Aree di attesa e punti di ricovero per protezione civile (RU) - Comune di Pontassieve is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoserver-ucvv.055055.it. Localization of hospitalization points and waiting areas of the population of the Civil Protection Plan. Coverage: Municipality of Pontassieve. The portal shows the English title as "Waiting areas and shelters for civil protection (RU) - Municipality of Pontassieve" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include geodata, c_g825, Comune di Pontassieve. The listing shows 4 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2021-03-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/noConditionsApply). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support emergency planning and critical-facility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
